escalations.title: handlebars@4.7.8 JavaScript Template Injection → Remote Code Execution
escalations.exploit_scenario: An attacker who can influence Handlebars template strings (e.g., via user-supplied template content or crafted input to any API that passes data into template compilation) can execute arbitrary JavaScript in the Node.js process with the server's privileges.
escalations.impact: Full server compromise. Attacker gains code execution as the backend service account. Data exfiltration, lateral movement, or service destruction possible.
escalations.recommendation: npm install handlebars@latest --prefix Source/Backend — then run npm audit to confirm zero critical CVEs.

escalations.title: protobufjs@7.5.4 Arbitrary Code Execution in Protobuf Deserialization
escalations.exploit_scenario: A crafted protobuf payload sent to any endpoint that deserializes protobuf data can trigger arbitrary code execution in the receiving process. The orchestrator and portal backend are both affected.
escalations.impact: Orchestrator or portal backend fully compromised. Pipeline integrity lost — an attacker could inject malicious agent tasks or alter run state.
escalations.recommendation: npm update protobufjs --prefix platform/orchestrator && npm update protobufjs --prefix portal/Backend — verify fixed version >=7.5.5 installed.

p2_findings.title: Direct DB calls from route handlers — 51 violations across 9 files
p2_findings.description: 51 direct getDb() calls in route handlers bypass the service layer. Violates CLAUDE.md hard rule: 'No direct DB calls from route handlers — use the service layer.'
p2_findings.recommendation: Move all SQL into service functions. Priority: cycles → pipelines → teamDispatches. Routes call services; services own getDb().

p2_findings.title: path-to-regexp ReDoS on route parameter matching
p2_findings.description: Crafted request paths can trigger catastrophic regex backtracking in the orchestrator's route matching, causing 100% CPU utilisation and request queue exhaustion.

p2_findings.title: picomatch ReDoS in path glob matching
p2_findings.description: Dev-dependency ReDoS risk in glob path matching. Lower runtime impact but should be resolved to keep npm audit clean.

p2_findings.title: vite / vitest / esbuild build tool CVEs — multiple advisories
p2_findings.description: Multiple moderate-to-high CVEs in vite, vitest, and esbuild. Build-time risk: a compromised build pipeline could inject malicious code into production bundles.
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update vite vitest esbuild --prefix Source/Frontend && npm update vite vitest esbuild --prefix portal/Frontend
